overview:
**Moderate fire danger holds today, kept in check by rain and thunderstorms moving through the high country.**
- Fire danger trends upward this week, rising from Moderate to High by Sunday and Monday (Sep 21-22) as drying returns.
- Today's storms bring 70% rain chances and areas to the east-northeast winds, with more showers and thunderstorms expected tonight and Thursday.
- No Red Flag Warning is active, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect in unincorporated Montrose County, with similar Stage 1 rules holding in Delta, Ouray, and BLM Southwest District lands across the region.
- The Elk Fire, burning northwest of Lake City in the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forest, is 7,257 acres and 73% contained, with full containment estimated Oct. 31.
- Fuels remain only lightly moistened (1000-hr fuels at 15%), so drying winds late week could quickly rebuild fire risk.
lead: Moderate fire danger holds today, kept in check by rain and thunderstorms moving through the high country.
